witness.title: THE WITNESS
witness.subtitle: A record belongs to everyone.
witness.text: You send the shutoff order, the relay contract and eight verified names through the town’s public line. You leave each chosen alias beside the name an institution gave it. The bell tries to add a thirteenth child. You identify the vessel instead. With the truth held in many places, it no longer needs one body to carry it. At the road, the sea makes an ordinary sound. You do not ask it to carry another name.

silence.title: THE SILENCE
silence.subtitle: An ending is not an erasure.
silence.text: Outer, inner, outer. The final brace breaks beneath your hand. The voices are allowed to stop. No new name replaces them. Saint Orison loses its impossible rooms, but the papers you carry do not prove everything that happened here. You leave the unproven spaces blank. This time, a blank is an admission of what you do not know—not an instruction to forget.

vessel.title: THE OFFERED NAME
vessel.subtitle: A burden has changed hands.
vessel.text: You give the machine your own copied pattern. The town grows quiet, and the others can leave, but the bell still has a container. A person at the gate recognizes your face. Your name will not stay with them. You do not ask remembrance as payment. Behind you, a new line appears in the visitor ledger. Its ink is still wet.
